units.text: Use of budget funds for purposes other than those designated, consisting in allocating funds of a budget within the budget system of the Russian Federation and paying monetary obligations for purposes wholly or partly inconsistent with the purposes specified in the budget law (decision), consolidated budget expenditure schedule, budget expenditure schedule, budget estimate, contract (agreement) or other document constituting the legal basis for provision of those funds, or allocating funds received from a budget within the budget system of the Russian Federation for purposes inconsistent with those specified in the contract (agreement) or other document constituting the legal basis for provision of those funds, where that action does not constitute a criminal offence, —
